explanation: Merges main (PRs #83 to #87) into the rhythm-scan change. From main: PR #87 fixes stale in-app text, agent maps, script headers and dated records without touching sealed or hash-pinned files;survey view and card tests cover GenePageSurvey, the source tiles and familyTeaser; symbolRenames.test.ts and queryIndex.test.ts cover reading a renamed gene across studies, pickStoredMember, compareCell and the Compare and compare-set downloads under the rename table, and the gene search tests cover Enter selecting the typed gene. From this branch: lombScargleFloor.test.ts pins the floor formula, its preconditions, a cap-breaking gappy pattern, the large-time-origin counterexample and a 200-design property (in the focused validation suite, 136 tests); rhythmCall.test.ts is the call and verdict decision table; the notes and results-table tests take lsFloor objects and a q: null row.
